name: Taleweavers Alliance Anthology
source:
A collection of five short stories in visual novel format created in Northern Ontario. 

* "From the Wetlands with Love" By Ellie Findlater
* "Eagle and the Star Maze" By Emmett Bear
* "Pottery Wheel" By Geovanni 'Geo' Laforme
* "Truth of the Self" By Michelle Wong
* "My Grandpa-Fly" By Daniel Bedard

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4356450/]Steam[/url]]
